csv_project_name: Planning for Fairview Park Development Phase 1
csv_agency: City of Salem, Public Works Department
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Salem ( City ) is requesting proposals from qualified firms ( Consultant ) to provide interpretive planning, historical research, oral history collection, and interpretive content development services for the Fairview Park Interpretive Space. The Consultant will coordinate closely with the City s park design consultant ( Design Consultant ), who is responsible for the overall site layout and park design elements within the Phase 1 project scope, including the interpretive space.
